name: Country investigations and legal cross-source context
description: Verifies country and case navigation preserves legal statuses while showing official allied designation sources.
steps: Open Command center
Confirm blue treaty allies and red selected adversaries on map legend
Select Russia in country selector and open Connections
Find case status descriptions and UK/Canadian official sanctions status cards
Check UK pending state remains clearly unknown until scheduled file has been collected
Inspect Canadian legal-regime counts, source link and original-file hash when available
expected: Eight curated DOJ cases remain source-linked; Canada and UK are distinct source categories, with legal regime counts never presented as nationality or guilt.

name: Physical energy observed production and date handling
description: Live physical production and electricity values use the new OWID energy data with source years, never invented trade links.
steps: Open Global systems and choose Russia
Scroll to Physical energy
Find Oil production and Gas production in TWh with an observation year, or a clear official-source unavailable message
Inspect electricity generation, net imports, and stated difference between domestic production and consumption
Open OWID source catalog link
expected: Country-specific annual physical energy records are reported with years and units; no claim of verified ownership, exports by destination or government sponsorship.

name: Source coverage truthfulness and evidence workflow
description: Keeps the 39 capabilities transparent, evidence references unreviewed and court outcomes unverified.
steps: Open Coverage audit on mobile and inspect International sanctions and ownership status
Open Connections and choose China
Read UK/Canada sanctions source status and missing or partial data warnings
Read case-outcome verification states and linked DOJ originals
Open Verification lab and inspect unreviewed provenance and missing immutable-object-lock warning
expected: The UI does not imply missing legal designations are zero or that unreviewed source links establish ownership or a verdict.

name: Global/regional collection and mobile navigation
covers: UK and Canada sanctions source health
description: Checks global and country views without losing navigation or source identity.
steps: Choose Global / regional in the header
Open Connections and inspect sources in global scope
Switch to South Korea and reopen Connections
Open World Factbook and then Global systems
Confirm country scope persists and physical energy data is either valid with an observation year or unavailable without fabricated figures
expected: Country selection follows the user; global sanctions totals and country legal-regime counts are labelled differently.

name: International API failure remains explicit
description: An upstream API error cannot be silently presented as an absent sanctioned party or zero fuel production.
steps: Select Russia and open Connections with simulated allied sanctions failure
Inspect the visible official-source unavailable notice
Verify the DOJ curated case references remain independent
Navigate to Global systems and verify physical energy observations remain separate
expected: An unavailable sanctions API is clearly reported, while unrelated source-backed case or energy evidence remains usable.
